children: The CAC 40 reversed early losses to close about 0.3% up at 8,306 on Monday, its highest level in a week and ranking among the strongest performers across Europe.

Technology provided the main support, led by STMicroelectronics (+4%) following a renewed enthusiasm for artificial intelligence after the launch of GPT-6 Astra by OpenAI, the startup's " world's smartest " model.
Schneider Electric and Legrand also advanced solidly, rising 2.7% and 2.4%, respectively.
TotalEnergies gained 1.5%, supported by higher oil prices and news that it had completed several major contractual and commercial milestones for the Papua LNG project.
Meanwhile, investors remained wary as geopolitical tensions drove energy prices higher, while expectations of additional rate hikes and mounting political uncertainty in Europe reinforced caution.
The ECB is widely expected to deliver a 25-bps rate hike on Thursday, while markets are also pricing in a Fed hike next week.

title: CAC 40 Closes at 1-Week High
